placeholder.title: facturar
placeholder.body: Quotes, invoices, credit notes and payments in guaraníes — with timbrado, per-rate IVA and WhatsApp delivery.
placeholder.status: Scaffold in place. The database lands in PR-2.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Ask your company's administrator to set a new one for you.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.body: Change your password whenever you like.
changePassword.forced: An administrator set a new password for your account. Choose your own to continue.

errors.invalid: We could not change the password. Check the details.
errors.wrong: The current password does not match.
errors.too_common: It is too easy to guess.
errors.unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.

users.title: Users
users.body: Add your team and decide what each person can do. Permissions are checked on the server, not only on screen.
users.name: Name
users.initialPasswordHint: At least {min} characters. Hand it over in person or by WhatsApp — they will be asked to change it when they sign in.

messages.passwordReset: Password set. They will be asked to change it when they sign in.

errors.taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.notFound: We could not find that user.
errors.lastAdmin: At least one active administrator must remain.
errors.too_common: It is too easy to guess.
errors.unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.

dashboard.intro: This is where what needs your attention today lives: overdue invoices, quotes to follow up and timbrado warnings.

tiles.todayHint: Overdue invoices and quotes awaiting follow-up appear here once you start issuing documents.
tiles.outstandingHint: Unpaid balance across your issued invoices.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.body: Once you add customers and issue quotes or invoices, the day's activity shows up on this screen.

setup.title: Add your timbrado before you invoice
setup.body: No invoice can be issued without a valid timbrado. Add its number, validity window and authorised range.

settings.title: Company details
settings.intro: These details are printed on every quote and invoice you issue.
settings.companyHint: Name, RUC and contact details that appear on your documents.
settings.rucHint: With its check digit, for example 80012345-0.
settings.defaultCurrencyHint: Used when creating a new document; you can change it per document.
settings.logoUrlHint: An https:// address for your logo. File upload arrives once storage is in place.

links.timbradosBody: Number, validity window and authorised range for issuing invoices.
links.usersBody: Your team and what each person can do.

errors.wrong_dv: The check digit does not match.

timbrados.title: Timbrados
timbrados.intro: The timbrado authorises your numbering. Without a valid one with numbers left, no invoice can be issued.
timbrados.startAtHint: Leave empty to start at the beginning of the range. Set only when the timbrado is added.
timbrados.createHint: Copy the details exactly as they appear on the DNIT authorisation.
timbrados.label: Timbrado {number} · {establishment}-{point}

empty.title: No timbrado added yet
empty.body: Add its number, validity window and authorised range so you can issue invoices.

alerts.blocked: You cannot issue invoices with this timbrado

errors.notFound: We could not find that timbrado.
errors.before_start: It must come after the start.
errors.out_of_range: It must fall inside the authorised range.
errors.already_issued: You cannot narrow the range below numbers already issued.
